notes:
{数量|すうりょう} refers to a countable quantity or amount, combining ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number) and ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (amount). It is somewhat formal and commonly appears in business, commerce, and official contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {数量|すうりょう}⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧: limited quantity
- {数量|すうりょう}⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧: quantity discount
- ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧{数量|すうりょう}: order quantity
- {数量|すうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to confirm the quantity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: amount (general, everyday — can be countable or uncountable)
- ⟦{分量|ぶんりょう}→分量：05474_bunryou⟧: portion, amount (especially for ingredients or dosage)
- ⟦{個数|こすう}→個数：19290_kosuu⟧: number of items (discrete, countable pieces)
- ⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧: number, count (native word, more general)

REGISTER:
{数量|すうりょう} is more formal than ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ or ⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧. It is typical of order forms, invoices, and written instructions.
